paragraphs: The Liao Dao is the Khitans' unique swordsman, carrying a massive blade into close combat.
The Khitans rose from the northeastern steppes to establish the Liao dynasty, ruling lands across northern China and the grasslands beyond.
A Liao Dao's strikes leave wounds that continue to damage an enemy after the blade has landed.
With Lamellar Armor, these warriors also return part of incoming melee damage to their attackers. Together, these abilities make a prolonged clash especially dangerous for their opponents.
